text: What kinds of websites are popular in your country?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Oh, in China, social media and online shopping websites are extremely popular. Like Taobao — it's kind of the Amazon of China. There's also Bilibili, like I mentioned, and the Chinese TikTok, and this app called Xiaohongshu — the "red note" app. They're all hugely popular in our country.
